name: gotham-gazette
description: Create and update Gotham Gazette weekly issues from Yahoo screenshots and editorial direction, with verified facts, league memory, original artwork, GitHub updates, and Vercel publishing.

interface.longDescription: Turn weekly Yahoo screenshots and Pat’s narrative direction into a complete Gotham Gazette issue. Seven coordinated skills handle intake, analysis, writing, two original illustrations, publication through the existing GitHub and Vercel setup, corrections, and continuity. Works on demand; does not schedule runs, obtain Yahoo API access, or send email.
defaultPrompt: Create this week’s Gotham Gazette from my screenshots and story direction.
Revise the current Gazette issue and publish the changes.
